ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white contiguous zones across 85% of both lobes; a central low-intensity black bifurcated 'butterfly' blob at the peduncle insertion; dark-grey to black border transitions along 40% of the trailing edge; yellowish-brown pigment clusters located in the mid-lateral region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth relative to the highest lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge; distinct sharp peaks (valleys and crests) ranging from 5-15 pixels in depth; highly irregular scalloping most pronounced at the lateral terminal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve with initial concavity extending from the median notch, transitioning to broad convexity through the mid-lobe, and ending in sharp posterior-curving lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups situated on the black-pigmented lateral tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, dark, near-parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the lower-right white quadrant of the right lobe; several shorter, unaligned dark streaks on the mid-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive yellowish-brown surface staining (diatom film) covering approximately 15% of the white surface area on the left lobe; possible minor tissue loss or deep indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe mid-section.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical central black pigmentation pattern at the fluke-peduncle junction characterized by jagged, high-contrast borders.
